entries.title: 99 Devils of Uzrah's Palace
entries.attribution: Copyright © 2026 JC Connors – 1Shot Adventures. All rights reserved. Free to download from 1shotadventures.com.
entries.author: JC Connors (thalcos)
entries.description: An Arabian Nights-inspired dungeon adventure for Shadowdark. The PCs come into the possession of an invitation to a grand event – the distribution of a vast treasure by an old pirate lord, the White Shark of Basra. Chartering a boat, they visit the island ruins where the White Shark plans to distribute his treasure and fool him into thinking they deserve a share. Little do they know, however, the ruins were once the palace of a legendary vizier, and it's now haunted by a capricious and very dangerous efreet who does not plan to let visitors escape his abode. Suitable for four-to-six 2nd or 3rd level characters.

entries.title: Army of the Damned
entries.attribution: Army of the Damned is a fan-made adventure module by Tomer Abramovici. All illustrations and names used from Magic: The Gathering, along with all D&D terms and rules, are properties of Wizards of the Coast. This is only a fan creation, not in any way made for sale. Maps and the Player’s Guide to Innistrad: Human Variants by /u/Nihilates; Geralf’s coded letter by /u/RanAngel.
entries.author: Tomer Abramovici (/u/SpiketailDrake)
entries.description: A gothic-horror adventure for four 1st-level characters on the plane of Innistrad, taking them to 5th. The party travels into Stensia to recover an artifact of the Church of Avacyn, clears a haunted manor, defends the village of Shadowgrange against an army of the walking dead, crosses the farbog and storms Mauer Estate to confront the necro-alchemist who built the horde.

entries.title: The Cold Bounty
entries.attribution: Copyright © 2026 JC Connors – 1Shot Adventures. All rights reserved. Free to download from 1shotadventures.com.
entries.author: JC Connors (thalcos)
entries.description: A cold mountain survival adventure for 4-6 2nd level D&D 5E characters. After a failed bounty hunt in the frozen Zark mountains, the PCs must survive a blizzard, navigate ice crevasses, and confront a sorcerer building a platinum golem. Suitable for 4-6 2nd level characters.
